description: Seed facts plus questions that need one of them. 'direct' questions share a keyword with the fact; 'paraphrase' questions don't, which is where keyword search is expected to fail. Plain-string memories are stored the way old memories were (no attribute, no keywords), like rows migrated from the first schema. Structured ones set kind/attribute/value and may supersede an older memory. 'updated' questions must find the newer fact and not the 'stale' one. 'series' questions with 'rank1' need the expected point ranked first. 'profile' questions need a fact the user never mentions, which only the always-in-context profile can supply.
